flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds show a sharp rise in the Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate. The projected Senate count now stands at 50-50, down from 53-47, which would leave the chamber split evenly. In [[Mississippi]], the Democrat Scott Colom gained ground sharply and is a predicted flip, while in [[Nebraska]] the Republican Pete Ricketts also strengthened sharply.
summaries.governor: Polymarket odds shifted sharply in four governor's races, led by [[Nevada]], where the Democrat Aaron Ford gained ground in a contest the market sees as a predicted flip. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Cindy Holscher also saw a steep rise in their chances. The Republican Phil Scott strengthened markedly in [[Vermont]], and the Democrat Tina Kotek climbed sharply in Oregon.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats' chances of winning the House rose by a sizable amount. Two North Carolina races saw sharp gains for the Democratic leaders, Cyril Jefferson in [[NC-06 (High Point & Kannapolis)]] and Lakesha Womack in [[NC-14 (Gastonia & Huntersville)]], and the market sees both as predicted flips. The projected seat count also changed to 248-186, down from 254-180, with Democrats still gaining control, and [[AZ-08 (Peoria)]] is a newly predicted flip.
